data.gender_notes: Sharvikaya is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Sharvikaya is a combination of two Sanskrit words - 'Sharva' and 'Kaya'. Sharva means 'god of beauty, love, and joy'. Kaya means 'body' or 'form'. Thus, Sharvikaya can be interpreted as the 'Goddess of beautiful form' or the 'Goddess of divine beauty'. The name Sharvikaya carries the meaning “Goddess of beauty and strength” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sharvikaya usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of beauty and strength and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sharvikaya is a powerful and divine name that is believed to bring beauty, strength, and intelligence to the bearer. It is a name that is deeply rooted in Hindu mythology and is often associated with the goddesses Lakshmi and Saraswati.
data.etymology: Sharvikaya belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of beauty and strength.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sharvikaya total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
